_doc: Run event kinds that change what a person's attention queue shows (GET /api/v1/attention): the run starts or ends, waits for someone (a gate, a reply, an approval, a merge watch after the pull request opened), pauses, resumes, a person decided, or a reminder is due. Only these nudge the requester and the responsible person (attention_changed); every other run event (tool, phase, session, push) only tells the sockets watching that run (job_changed). Each nudge makes every open tab re-read the queue, which costs a database connection.
